title: Supplier appendix: A3 plywood CNC
status: FOR QUOTATION — supplier confirmation is required before production.
birch_plywood_raw: Raw, uncoated birch plywood for laser cutting
laser: CO₂ laser through-cutting; nominal finished geometry in millimetres, scale 1:1
no_engraving: None. Part IDs appear on reference maps only.
pending: To be confirmed by the supplier
kerf: Apply laser kerf compensation once to obtain nominal dimensions. Confirm edge taper and tolerances before production.
spacing: Laser layouts use {spacing:g} mm between parts and {margin:g} mm side margins. Router cutting requires a separate layout with wider lanes.
packing: Retain every small part, inspect quantities and pack by part ID. Reference maps identify the narrow strips.
no_substitution: Use 3 mm and 6 mm plywood only; do not substitute another thickness (4, 6.5, 8 or 9 mm). Changes to thickness require a new fit check.
production_only: Machine input is only Moomin-House-Supplier-Cut.dxf, or the operation files and the indexed production pages. Specification, inventory and reference maps are not machine input.
page_note: Page numbers in this index refer to this standalone supplier PDF. Production pages retain their physical sheet size and contain no annotations.
summary_desc: Summary of raw material requirements (A3 sheets) and total cut elements grouped by nominal plywood thickness.

one_piece: EVERY FABRICATION SECTION MUST FIT ONE A3 BLANK. Only explicitly designed base, floor and ring sections are joined; never split walls, pillars or roof skins.
capacity: Stock sizes, whole parts and indicative costs
roof_fit: An R01/R06 panel measures {width:.2f} × {height:.2f} mm. It fits one A3 297 × 420 mm blank with a 10 mm margin. Every roof panel remains one piece of plywood. Joining A4 printouts joins paper only.
capacity_note: Confirm that the laser shop accepts 3 mm spacing and both 3 and 6 mm birch plywood. Check its bed size and stock availability. Retail A3 blanks do not confirm the cutting shop inventory.
cost_note: Checked {date}: retail A3 3 mm blanks cost {low:.2f}–{high:.2f} PLN depending on grade. The {count} A3 sheets containing roof panels therefore represent {total_low:.2f}–{total_high:.2f} PLN of raw material. This is a benchmark, not a supplier quotation. It excludes A4 blanks, cutting, machine setup and delivery.
fallback: If the supplier cannot provide suitable stock or the quotation is unacceptable, cut the whole roof panels by hand using the A4 templates. Do not shrink or split a panel to fit a machine.
cnc_process: Laser through-cuts in 3 and 6 mm plywood. Use Moomin-House-Supplier-Cut.dxf. Drill blind features separately. Dimensions are nominal, in millimeters, 1:1.
a3_stock: Use A3 blanks, 297 × 420 mm, grouped by thickness: 3 and 6 mm only.
retained_edges: Fixed walls (420 mm) use the full blank length: their two 420 mm end edges are the factory edges of the sheet and are not cut. Those blanks must be 420 mm (±0.3) with square, clean ends, otherwise cut the walls from 440 mm stock. Opening walls (418 mm) are cut on all sides, 1 mm in from each end. Long strips (pillars 402 mm, battens up to 412 mm) get what is left of the 10 mm end margin. Confirm hold-down access.
machining_faces: Operation names: top = the upper face as drawn, d = diameter, z = depth [mm]. All through holes are drilled from the top. No flipped (underside) machining is requested: underside countersinks and recesses, and holes under D{min_drill:g}, are drilled by the customer (list on page {page}).
reference_warning: REFERENCE ONLY — finished edges and part IDs; do not machine this page.
summary_note: The complete workshop book is A4 only. Send Moomin-House-Supplier.pdf and its operation CSV/DXF/SVG files to the company. Production pages in that separate PDF are native A3, grouped by thickness and operation. Page numbers below refer to the separate supplier PDF.
tooling: For separate router operations: largest end mill D{tool:g} mm, inside radius up to {radius:g} mm. Existing corner relief remains unchanged. Router cutting of profiles requires wider lanes and new nesting.
grain: Face grain along the 420 mm sheet length: do not turn walls, pillars, battens or roof panels across it when re-nesting.
thickness_spec: Nominal 3 and 6 mm only; measured thickness must lie inside: {bands}. 6.5 mm or 9 mm boards do not fit the design.
grade: Grade {grade} (grade 2 on both faces) for every sheet. Interior glue: EN 314-2 class 1 or better. Formaldehyde: E1 or lower. Request the EN 71-3 statement for the board.
contact: Customer, contact, number of sets and delivery date: ______________________________
checklist: Board: grade {grade} birch plywood in 3 and 6 mm, A3 297 × 420 mm. Measured thickness must fit the bands on page 2.
Fixed walls: 420 mm blanks with square factory ends, or 440 mm stock to trim (tell us which).
Laser cutting for both thicknesses: confirm edge taper, charring and the {spacing:g} mm lanes.
Blind pockets and holes: confirm separate drilling or routing. These features are absent from the laser cut file.
Part retention for strips, battens and small trim: confirm the laser shop method.
Tolerances: outline and hole position (proposed ±0.2 mm), pocket depth (±0.2 mm).
Laser lanes: {spacing:g} mm between parts, {margin:g} mm side margins. Router cutting requires a separate layout.
Marking: no engraving; parts bagged per sheet with the reference map, small parts counted.
Edges: remove loose char and burrs. Return small parts and offcuts.
Price for the whole set, setup, delivery date.
hand_title: Drilled by the customer — do not machine
hand_note: The laser cut file excludes all blind holes and pockets. Drill these separately. The list below also records underside features and holes below the supplier minimum drill diameter.
files: Moomin-House-Supplier.pdf (this file): specification, inventory, reference maps and the A3 production pages.
Moomin-House-Supplier.csv: one row per sheet operation, with page and DXF name.

Moomin-House-Supplier-Cut.dxf: everything to cut in one DXF R12 file (mm, 1:1), cutting lines only: outlines, openings and through holes, no frames or text. One layer and colour per thickness: CUT_3MM (red) and CUT_6MM (green). The A3 sheets follow the reference maps: rows by thickness, left to right. Fixed-wall outlines are closed; on a 420 mm blank their ends lie on the factory edge. Blind pockets and holes (in the operation files) and the customer's features on page 4 are not in it.
output/dxf/PLY*-cnc-all-layers.dxf: one DXF R12 per sheet, every operation on its own layer (mm).
output/dxf/PLY*-cnc-<operation>.dxf/.svg: one file per sheet and operation (mm, 1:1).
output/dxf/PLY*-layout.svg: sheet overview with part IDs (reference only).

hand_words.small: smaller than the D{min_drill:g} minimum drill
hand_words.underside: underside feature; the sheet is not flipped
